For length L from 2 to n, for each i with j=i+L-1, initialize DP[i][j]=empty set. For each split k from i to j-1, combine every x in DP[i][k] with every y in DP[k+1][j] using op[k]: if '+', add x+y; if '-', add x-y; if '*', add x*y. Insert results into DP[i][j].
